coverageGrid.methodology: 40x40 grid (1600 points) over the real network's lat/lng extent padded by 0.03 degrees (~3.3km); reachable = within 2000m of a metro station or 1200m of a bus stop (ROUTING_CONSTANTS.MAX_WALK_TO_METRO_M / MAX_WALK_TO_BUS_M, the exact thresholds route generation enforces).

stages.name: Reliability + confidence interval + Monte Carlo risk (all candidates)

calibrationCurve.note: Synthetic demo observations (historicalReliabilityService.generateSyntheticJourneyObservations, seeded) — not real user data. 80/20 chronological split, mean/stddev from the training half, standard normal z critical values (textbook, not fitted).

learningCurve.note: Synthetic, noisy, balanced two-class pairwise dataset (mlEvaluationService.generateSyntheticPreferenceDataset, seeded) — not real user choices. Same held-out test set (the stratified 20%) evaluated at each training-set size.

explanationTags: 🎯 Predictable arrival time based on historical data

sensitivityNote: Each constant perturbed +/-20%, full candidate generation + ranking re-run for all 22 scenarios against live OSRM, compared to the unperturbed baseline top-ranked route by structural path signature (not by ephemeral route id). Most sensitive: MAX_WALK_TO_METRO_M +20% at 5% (1/22 scenarios).
